functions.name: Benchmark
functions.summary: Benchmark benchmarks a single function. It is useful for creating custom benchmarks that do not use the "go test" command.

functions.name: CoverMode
functions.summary: CoverMode reports what the test coverage mode is set to. The values are "set", "count", or "atomic". The return value will be empty if test coverage is not enabled.

functions.name: Coverage
functions.summary: Coverage reports the current code coverage as a fraction in the range [0, 1]. If coverage is not enabled, Coverage returns 0.

functions.name: Init
functions.summary: Init registers testing flags. These flags are automatically registered by the "go test" command before running test functions, so Init is only needed when calling functions such as Benchmark without using "go test".

functions.name: Main
functions.summary: Main is an internal function, part of the implementation of the "go test" command. It was exported because it is cross-package and predates "internal" packages. It is no longer used by "go test" but preserved, as much as possible, for other systems that simulate "go test" using Main, but Main sometimes cannot be updated as new functionality is added to the testing package. Systems simulating "go test" should be updated to use [MainStart].
